pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo āsandiṃpi pallaṅkaṃpi paribhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo āsandiṃpi pallaṅkaṃpi paribhuñjissanti seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo āsandiṃpi pallaṅkaṃpi paribhuñjissanti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo āsandiṃpi pallaṅkaṃpi paribhuñjantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo āsandiṃpi pallaṅkaṃpi paribhuñjissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī āsandiṃ vā pallaṅkaṃ vā paribhuñjeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc42:2.1.10: tasmiṃ abhinisīdati vā abhinipajjati vā āpatti pācittiyassa.
